name: Chase Freedom Rise Credit Card

apr.notes: Purchase APR 18.24% to 27.74% variable based on creditworthiness. Cash Advance APR 28.49% variable. Penalty APR up to 29.99%. Variable APRs based on 6.75% Prime Rate as of 3/24/2026. Maximum APR 29.99%.

fx_fee.notes: 3% of the amount of each transaction in U.S. dollars.

credit_required.notes: Best for: New to Credit and Students. Having at least $250 in Chase checking or savings accounts increases chances of approval.

rewards.currency_label: Cash Back rewards (tracked as points; each $1 in Cash Back = 100 points)
rewards.redemption_notes: Cash Back rewards tracked as points; each $1 in Cash Back = 100 points.

signup_bonus.description: $25 statement credit after setting up automatic payments during the first 3 months from account opening and remaining enrolled for at least 90 consecutive days.

benefits.title: $25 Statement Credit for Automatic Payments
benefits.description: $25 statement credit after you set up automatic payments during the first 3 months from account opening and remain enrolled for at least 90 consecutive days.

benefits.title: 3% Cash Back on Dining (Limited Time)
benefits.description: Earn 3% cash back total on dining purchases (restaurants including takeout and eligible delivery) for new cardmembers within first 6 months, or until $6,000 in dining purchases, whichever occurs first. 1.5% additional on top of base 1.5%.

notes: Verified from official Chase product page and pricing & terms page. Annual fee $0, purchase APR 18.24%-27.74% variable, cash advance APR 28.49%, penalty APR up to 29.99%, foreign transaction fee 3%. 3% dining bonus (capped at $6,000 in first 6 months), 1.5% base on all other purchases. $25 statement credit for auto payments enrollment.
